cases.given: One owning task and a clean INITIAL pass.

expect.todo_index_entry: Title, current status, and task-file link only.
expect.no_finding_result: READY may state accepted without substantive debate.
expect.chat: Normal task outcome, user-relevant changes, verification, and report link only; no review-report heading or report metadata.

cases.given: The report is created before INITIAL (1), with PENDING state and no finding yet.

expect.empty_ledger_statement: No issue has been raised yet and review is still underway.

cases.given: A review has a blocker, an Editor response, and a later resolution; another user-owned question remains unresolved; on a third finding, the Reviewer maintains a material risk while the Editor disagrees with that risk assessment.

debate_fields: Editor audit: Current Adequacy; Minimal Resolution; Blast Radius; Proportionality
expect.disagreement_preserved: The Reviewer challenge and Editor disagreement both remain visible without fabricating agreement.

cases.given: A Reviewer NOTE is acknowledged by the Editor and requires no artifact change.
A Reviewer labels a preferred abstraction as BLOCKER but cannot identify a violated criterion, observable evidence, material risk, and required outcome.

expect.allowed_result: Downgrade to QUESTION or NOTE, or omit it.

cases.given: A valid finding suggests a new cross-component coordinator, while a local guard satisfies the same required outcome with a smaller blast radius and fewer assumptions.
The current solution already satisfies the required outcome and the Reviewer suggestion adds complexity without demonstrated risk reduction.
A valid finding identifies a violated criterion, observable evidence, material risk, and required outcome, but the Reviewer provides no suggested remedy.
An approved report contains Gate, review state, stop reason, Reviewer, round, findings, verification, and external-action authorization, and the user did not ask for review details.

chat_forbidden: Final Review Report or equivalent heading
Gate, review state, or stop reason

cases.given: A reviewed artifact changes after APPROVED.
Multiple existing tasks plausibly own the review.

expect.chat: Exact ownership question without a report link.

cases.given: All findings were answered, but one user-owned decision remains.

expect.chat: Exact question, evidence, risk, resume condition, and report link only.

cases.given: Only the report ledger projection, owning task summary, and exact todo index status change.
Two agents update different active tasks concurrently.

expect.todo_index_change: Only the exact owning entry may change.
